export_one_scan: export one Scannet scan by loading mesh vertices, semantic labels, instance labels, and bounding boxes, then saving them as numpy files
batch_export: batch export all Scannet training scans by iterating over scan names and exporting each one to numpy data files
run_batch_load_scannet_data: run the batch_load_scannet_data.py script to export Scannet training scene data with vertices and ground truth labels
load_scannet_export: use the load_scannet_data export function to parse Scannet mesh files, aggregation JSON, segmentation JSON, and metadata into vertices and labels
filter_scannet_instances: filter Scannet scene data by removing don't care class IDs and subsampling vertices to a maximum point count
